source.source_git: exact merged commit containing the admission; set by root at staging
source.source.json: {source_git, files}: every rsna/**/*.py plus admission REQUIRED_SOURCE, sha256 per file, 8 MiB cap
source.recovery-source-manifest.json: byte-for-byte JSON equal to source.json files (the unchanged GPU wrapper's --source-manifest)

funding.json.existing_liabilities_bytes: root measures and retains every current obligation (positive integer)
funding.json.required_free_bytes: 16777216 + existing_liabilities_bytes + reserve_bytes; fresh disk_usage(root).free is rechecked inside the step

proposed_CPU_step.command: srun --jobid=<root-owned evc31 allocation> --overlap --ntasks=1 --cpus-per-task=1 --gpus=0 env -u CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES PYTHONPATH=/tmp/rsna-patch-focus-admission-20261014-v1/code PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 python -B /tmp/rsna-patch-focus-admission-20261014-v1/code/scripts/newton/admit_patch_focus_inputs.py --root /tmp/rsna-patch-focus-admission-20261014-v1
proposed_CPU_step.output: /tmp/rsna-patch-focus-admission-20261014-v1/CPU-accepted.json (exclusive create, 1 MiB cap, sanitized hashes/counts only)

future_GPU_recovery_after_CPU_acceptance.wrapper: scripts/newton/run_patch_focus_recovery.py (unchanged canonical trainer; reference full, then control and candidate full/stop1/resume, sequential on one assigned GPU)
future_GPU_recovery_after_CPU_acceptance.requires: accepted patch-focus CPU receipt, one assigned GPU on the owning allocation (no extra node), separate root patch-focus funding of the 12 GiB output cap plus 20 GiB reserve and runtime; the dense 12 GiB engineering funding is not reused
future_GPU_recovery_after_CPU_acceptance.measures: per-run elapsed_seconds and cuda_peak_memory_bytes; added versus the source-slot reference fit

future_production_after_accepted_GPU_rec.checkpoint_upper_bound_bytes: computed inside the CPU receipt from each arm's learned_parameters: (epochs/submission_every_epochs + 1) * 3 * 4 * learned + 1 GiB

funding_scope_note: CPU admission control bytes only. The existing 12 GiB dense engineering funding is NOT patch-focus funding; GPU recovery output/checkpoint/runtime funding must be declared separately by root before any dispatch.
gradient_probe: first fitting-order study with both observed and masked fitting targets (fitting labels/masks only); one train-mode CPU forward/backward per reference/control/candidate model, no optimizer step
